From raw NASA files to every number on the tabs

This page shows the whole path: the raw CSV files exactly as downloaded, what we checked in them, how we cleaned them, how the tabs compute their numbers, and how we checked the tabs. Everything below is read from files this project wrote, not typed in.

10raw files, never edited (8 Giovanni series, FIRMS archive, FIRMS near-real-time)
717,185raw fire detections, of which 647,193 survive cleaning
8,510automated checks, 0 mismatches
8 × 288monthly values, every month present, no fill values

1 · The pipeline

Five steps, and a check at every step. Nothing is estimated by a language model; the tabs compute their own numbers in the page from the clean tables.

1 · Raw files8 Giovanni CSV filesFIRMS MODIS archive717,185 fire detectionsnever edited
2 · Auditcoverage and gapsfill values, duplicatesunits and value rangeschecksums recorded
3 · Cleanfires: vegetation fires,confidence 30% or moreseries: units converted,nothing smoothed or filled
4 · AnalyseMann–Kendall, Sen slopepre-whitening, seasonal testPettitt step, Spearmanfalse-discovery filter
5 · Show3 tabs in Climate Watchnumbers computed in thepage from clean tablesno network, no model
Checked at every step: 8,510 automated checks, 0 mismatches. Raw file → clean tables (every count re-derived a second way), and clean tables → tab numbers (recomputed with other software).

3 · How we clean them

Every rule, why it is there, and how many rows it touches.

DataWhat we doWhyEffect
FireKeep type = 0 (a vegetation fire)FIRMS also reports volcanoes, other static land sources and offshore detections−38,346 rows
FireKeep confidence ≥ 30MODIS gives each detection a 0–100% confidence; low values are likely false alarms−31,646 rows
FireFire season = November–April, labelled by the year it endsthat is when almost all burning happens, and a season is not cut in half at New Year629,913 rows (97.3% of clean)
FireAqua and Terra counted separately (and together on request)different overpass times (about 10:30 and 13:30); Aqua starts 2002-07-08, Terra 2001-11-16447,469 Aqua, 199,724 Terra
FireEach fire goes to the nearest NASA SEDAC province centre pointno province borders are shipped; an approximation (median distance to the nearest centre 41 km)every clean row
FireNear-real-time file ignorednot final quality and overlaps the archive's last weeks115 rows unused
SeriesSkip the Giovanni header; drop any value ≥ 1e10 (Giovanni's missing-data code)so a fill value can never be averaged in as a real measurement0 found in 8 files
SeriesEach timestamp becomes the first day of its monthone row per month, same index for every series2,304 rows
SeriesConvert units: rain × 86,400 (kg m⁻² s⁻¹ to mm/day); black carbon and PM2.5 × 1e9 (kg m⁻³ to µg/m³)so values are in units people can read3 of 8 series
SeriesNothing else: no smoothing, no interpolation, no gap filling, no outlier removalthe tests see exactly what NASA produced0 values changed

6 · How we checked it

Two kinds of check. First, the clean tables are re-derived from the raw file a second way and compared. Second, every tab's own JavaScript is compared with numbers recomputed from the raw files using other software (pymannkendall, scipy, statsmodels). Largest p-value difference on any tab: 8.2e-08.

StepWhat was comparedChecksResult
Raw files audited8 Giovanni files and the FIRMS archive: row counts, date coverage, gaps, fill values, duplicates, empty cells, value ranges, copies on diskall passpass
Raw → clean tablesEvery season total, every monthly count, every province count, every map-square sum, and 600 random map squares, re-counted from the raw FIRMS file with different code (a plain distance matrix instead of a KD-tree)2,4950 failures
Clean tables → Fire tab14 choices of satellite and seasons: totals, season counts, province and region counts, months, trend, p-value, step test, compared with pymannkendall and scipy1,4910 mismatches
Province trends7 windows × 25 provinces: counts, Mann–Kendall p, % per decade and the false-discovery flag (statsmodels)7790 mismatches
Clean tables → Soot & haze tab24 choices of measure, satellite and years: monthly and seasonal correlations, climatology, dry-season trend9300 mismatches
Clean tables → Rain, soil & heat tab40 choices of series and years: rate, 95% interval, three p-values, seasonal tests, monthly climatology, rain-record ratio and its step2,8150 mismatches
Our statistics code vs libraries28 series: Mann–Kendall S and p, Sen slope, pre-whitened p, Pettitt p against pymannkendall and scipy28 seriesdifferences ≤ 1.1e-16

One-off, not repeatable from this folder: we measured the nearest-centre rule against real province borders (geoBoundaries, a non-NASA file we do not ship). 83% of Aqua fires land in the same province either way, province shares rank-correlate at ρ = 0.95, the top five provinces are the same set, and the largest single share moves by 3.6 points (Battambang (6.9% by border, 3.3% by nearest centre)). So read the province ranking as solid and exact percentages as ±3–4 points.

7 · What this does not prove

  • The eight Giovanni series are each an area average over one box (102.3–107.6°E, 10.4–14.7°N), which also covers parts of Thailand, Laos, Vietnam and the Gulf of Thailand. They cannot say where inside Cambodia something changes.
  • Seven of the eight are model output (NASA MERRA-2), not measurements. Only the GPM rain is a satellite-based estimate, and fire is the one direct satellite observation.
  • Fire counts are hotspots seen at overpass, not area burned. Province shares come from nearest-centre assignment (±3–4 points).
  • The Giovanni files end in December 2024; the fire file runs to August 2026.
  • Our checks show the tabs compute the right numbers from these files. They do not show the files are the truth: the MERRA-2 rain, soil and wet-bulb series step after 2016–17 while the satellite rain does not, and we have not identified why.

8 · Run it yourself

# 1. audit the raw files and write the clean data (needs the two raw folders; never edits them)
python fire-watch/tools/audit_raw.py --firms <folder with fire_archive_*.csv> --giovanni <folder with the 8 Giovanni CSVs>

# 2. build the fire tables from the raw FIRMS file, then re-derive them a second way and compare
python fire-watch/tools/build_fire_watch.py tables <FIRMS folder>
python fire-watch/tools/build_fire_watch.py verify <FIRMS folder>

# 3. build the tabs and put them in the Climate Watch page
python fire-watch/tools/build_fire_watch.py page
python fire-watch/tools/build_fire_watch.py inject

# 4. check the tabs against an independent recomputation from the raw files
python fire-watch/tools/verify/make_expected.py fire-watch/data <FIRMS folder> <Giovanni folder>
#    then serve the repo (python -m http.server), open climate-watch-cambodia.html and paste fire-watch/tools/verify/browser_check.js in the console

The raw files are in fire-watch/raw-data/ (the 57 MB FIRMS archive is gzipped: unpack it with gunzip -k first; checksums are in SHA256SUMS.txt). Checked on 2026-11-14.
